After discovering she was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] utilized '''several lightsabers''' through her career as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[New Jedi Order]].

==History==
===Thrawn campaign===
[[File:HTTESB Leia Organa Solo lightsaber remote.png|thumb|left|150px|Leia practises lightsaber combat against a remote.]]
Although her twin brother [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] offered to make one for her,<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Leia created her first lightsaber by herself, under his tutelage. Supplied with the same tools Luke had used to construct [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|his green lightsaber]], Leia journeyed into a wilderness to find the components she required, accompanied by [[R2-D2]], while Luke awaited her return. After three days, she located the necessary components, and on the eighth, she emerged from the wilderness with R2, carrying her newly built lightsaber, and impressing Luke with how quickly she had succeeded.<ref name="HTTES" /> When ignited, this lightsaber produced a green-white blade.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Leia practised her lightsaber combat skills against a [[Remote/Legends|training remote]], under Luke's instruction.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

The lightsaber's creation was prompted by events during the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], when several kidnapping attempts targetting the pregnant Leia were instigated by [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Grand Admiral Thrawn]]. On [[Bpfassh]], Leia's husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used it to disable a decoy [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transport]] resembling the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', by cutting through its [[korfaise]] coolant lines. Leia later used the lightsaber herself to [[Mission_to_Kashyyyk_(Thrawn_campaign)|fight]] Thrawn's [[Noghri]] servants in [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], killing one by slicing him almost in half, before carving an exit through the floor of the house in which she had been staying. While traversing Kashyyyk's [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] with the aid of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], she used an unorthodox tactic of attaching her lightsaber to a rope and swinging it like a pendulum into a pursuing [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], destroying its repulsorlift generator, and sending it falling into the mists below.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

[[File:Dark Force Rising 5 Leia Organa Solo green lightsaber with Noghri.png|thumb|120px|left|Leia ignites her green lightsaber before the Noghri.]]
Convincing [[Khabarakh]], the last surviving would-be kidnapper, to lead her to his homeworld of [[Honoghr]], Leia [[mission to Honoghr|journeyed there]] to expose the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]]'s treachery to the Noghri people, bringing her lightsaber along with her. When the Noghri leaders doubted her claims, Leia used her [[Force power]]s to [[Telekinesis/Legends|draw, ignite and levitate]] the lightsaber before her, displaying the abilities and distinctive weapon of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|her father]], a cultural hero to the Noghri, and so commanding their respect. Upon being afforded the chance to speak, she demanded that one of their [[decon droid]]s be brought to her, and used the lightsaber to cut it open and reveal the poison that it had been seeding among their world's flora, in order to keep them indebted to the Empire.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

Following the birth of her twin children, Leia was forced to defend herself from [[Raid on Coruscant (Thrawn Crisis)|another kidnapping plot]] on Coruscant, using her lightsaber to attempt an escape through the window of her family's suite in the old [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. Later, when Leia was attacked and disarmed by the insane [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] picked up the lightsaber and used it to kill both C'baoth and his servant [[Luuke Skywalker]].<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]'' </ref>

===Operation Shadow Hand===
[[File:Dark Empire Leia Organa Solo igniting blue lightsaber.png|thumb|120px|Leia's blue lightsaber from Byss.]]
During [[Operation Shadow Hand]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Leia briefly used a [[Vima-Da-Boda's lightsaber|10,000 year old lightsaber]] that she was gifted by an old [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Vima-Da-Boda]].<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref><ref name="Dark Empire 4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref><ref name="Endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] (4th issue)</ref> On [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], Leia used the blue-bladed lightsaber to slice the hand off an [[Imperial Sentinel]] before the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made it explode, proclaiming that such an old weapon was not worthy of her.<ref name="Dark Empire 4" /> 

When Palpatine offered to teach Leia, luring her with knowledge from a [[Tedryn Holocron|Jedi Holocron]], she defied him and escaped with said device, including a lightsaber with which it was being showcased.<ref name="Dark Empire 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref> She returned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]'s [[Pinnacle Base]] with the new lightsaber, and later brought it aboard the Emperor's flagship ''[[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|Eclipse]]''. Using the blue-bladed lightsaber to duel Luke, who had been mentally tormented into becoming Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], she eventually convinced him to renounce the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Dark Empire 6" />

===New responsibilities===
{{Talesstart}}
[[File:Tales 16 The Other Leia Organa Solo igniting blue lightsaber.png|thumb|left|180px|Leia ignites her blue lightsaber to defend her family.]]
Around the time of her succession of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|President of the New Republic]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Leia reevaluated her role in Luke Skywalker's [[New Jedi Order]], after aggressively using her blue lightsaber against Imperial sympathizers on Coruscant.<ref name="Other">[[Star Wars Tales 16|''Star Wars Tales'' 16]] ("[[The Other (comic story)|The Other]]")</ref> 

Attacked while visiting a park with her three children, Leia used her lightsaber to defend her family from the assailants, successfully deflecting their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and ultimately neutralizing them, including severing the arm of her last opponent. Stopping herself from enacting further aggression by lightsaber on her downed enemy, her fears of following in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|her father's]] footsteps were reinforced, and she chose to prioritize her obligations to her new leadership position and family over advancing her Jedi skills.<ref name="Other"/>
{{Talesend}}

===Nam Chorios===
[[File:Beldorian Leia Duel TEC.jpg|alt=A Human woman crossing lightsabers with a towering, muscular Hutt.|thumb|Leia duels Beldorian on Nam Chorios.]]
After being kidnapped and imprisoned on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the now-[[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] Leia was forced to take up a lightsaber once more in order to aid her escape. Wielding her self-built pale blue lightsaber, she used it to illuminate her passage through darkened areas, and to kill the insectile [[droch]]s that attacked her, although she lightly injured herself with the blade in her drugged and exhausted state. She later sparred with [[Callista Ming]], regaining some confidence in her abilities after having let her training lapse in recent years. She would ultimately use her lightsaber to duel and kill the fallen [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Jedi [[Beldorion]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />

===Almania Crisis===
By [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Leia had continued to practice her lightsaber skills against training remotes. She later took her lightsaber with her when she travelled to [[Almania]] to rescue Luke from the [[Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]]. During their escape, Leia relinquished her saber to an unarmed and injured Luke, while she supported him with blaster fire to defeat Kueller.<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

===Red lightsaber===
Leia resumed her lightsaber exercises in private by [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], on the rare occasions allowed by her duties as Chief-of-State, but she believed she was not yet a true Jedi, perceiving her training to still be incomplete. Disagreeing with her assessment, and observing her recent reluctance to carry her lightsaber, Luke gifted Leia with a ruby-red blade that he had built from scratch, proclaming that while her training had been different to his, it was nonetheless complete.<ref name="Ambush" /> 

Accepting the red lightsaber, Leia immediately challenged Luke to a duel, relishing the opportunity to test the physical skills that she had rarely employed in recent years. Though lacking finesse, her speed and agility caught Luke off-guard, and she was able to disarm him of his own weapon. Having evaluated the new blade in combat, Leia felt that the new lightsaber was superior to her previous one,<ref name="Ambush" /> and took it with her to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>

After being imprisoned in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet's]] [[Corona House/Legends|Corona House]] by the [[Human League]], Leia and Mara Jade were able to effect an escape, with the former successfully retrieving her lightsaber. Leia used the red saber to illuminate their way in the darkened building and slash the hinges from locked doors blocking their path. To locate Mara's [[slave circuit]] controller for summoning [[Jade's Fire|her ship]], Leia cut away a chunk of [[Stresscrete/Legends|stresscrete]] under which it had been buried, following an earlier rocket attack. While attempting to summon the ship, they were discovered by League troopers, with Leia using the blade to deflect blaster fire from and decapitate one of the soldiers, then redirect a thrown [[Grenade/Legends|mini-detonator]] back at another, who was caught in the ensuing explosion.<ref name="Assault at Selonia" />

===Later career===
Leia carried her lightsaber during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. At the [[Combined Clans Center Building]] in [[Drev'starn]], [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], Leia's weapon was noticed by Secretary [[Ceok Orou'cya]], who pleaded that she use it to defend them from a mob approaching the building. When the mob forced their way into the building's atrium, Leia verbally confronted the group after igniting the blade, the sight of which temporarily halted their advance. However, when a blaster fight ensued between [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] guards and members of the crowd, she deactivated her weapon to avoid being forced to kill or maim anybody. Scaling a wall to escape, and wishing to prevent the building's occupants coming to harm, Leia threw the lightsaber down to her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], after spotting him on the balcony above the main stairway, which he used to cut the latter free, blocking access to the upper floors.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

[[File:Leia FOTJdppdf.jpg|thumb|left|Leia's lightsaber in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].]]
While training under [[Saba Sebatyne]] in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Leia's previous lightsabers were taken by her new [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], who told her that they did not reflect her skills anymore, and that it was time that she build a new lightsaber, one fit for a fully-fledged [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Leia built a blue-bladed lightsaber,<ref name="The Swarm War" /> feeling that her new weapon was a signifant improvement on her old one. She also felt a stronger connection to it, because it carried a part of her history, namely a shard of the [[Kaiburr crystal]], a [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifact]] that she and Luke had first encountered on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], [[Duel on Mimban|three decades earlier]]. Employing the fragment as a focusing crystal,<ref name="EGttF" /> Leia used the lightsaber throughout the [[Swarm War]] and thereafter.<ref name="The Swarm War" />

==Behind the scenes==
When asked about what type of lightsaber she would like during an appearance on [[Wikipedia:The Late Show with Stephen Colbert|''The Late Show with Stephen Colbert'']] when promoting her new book [[Wikipedia:The Princess Diarist|''The Princess Diarist'']], [[Carrie Fisher]] said she liked the color purple.<ref name="CBT">{{WebCite|url=http://www.cinemablend.com/news/1588480/star-wars-what-color-lightsaber-leia-should-have-according-to-carrie-fisher|text=Star Wars: What Color Lightsaber Leia Should Have, According To Carrie Fisher|author=Corey Chichizola|date=2016-11-22|archivedate=20161122190052}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies===
In ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|The Thrawn Trilogy]]'', the text of ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' and ''[[The Last Command]]'' specifically call Leia's first lightsaber "green-white," in Chapter 24 and 27, respectively, and is also depicted as green on the cover of the latter, as wielded by Mara Jade. However, while the [[Dark Force Rising 5|comic adaptation of ''Dark Force Rising'']] correctly depicts the lightsaber as green, it appears as blue in those of ''[[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|Heir to the Empire]]'' and [[The Last Command 6|''The Last Command'']]. 

While the novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' implies that Luke built Leia's first green lightsaber, the short story "[[Leia's Lightsaber]]" in the ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'' describes her building the weapon herself. However, ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'' ignores the ''Sourcebook'', and states that Leia had never built her own lightsaber, when Luke gifts her with a new red-bladed one.

In the comic ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire|Dark Empire]]'', Leia acquires a new lightsaber on Byss, which is depicted as blue in [[Cam Kennedy]]'s panel art for [[Dark Empire 6|issue 6]]. [[Dave Dorman]]'s cover art for that issue instead portrays it as green, although this inconsistency in blade color between page and cover also exists for Palpatine's and Luke's sabers (blue and red, respectively, to red and green). 

[[File:The Last Command 6 Leia Organa Solo lightsaber hilt.png|thumb|175px|Depiction of Leia's lightsaber hilt from ''The Last Command'' comic adaptation.]]
While Leia's lightsaber is described as pale blue and sky-colored in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', it cannot be the same as that which she obtained in ''Dark Empire'', as she recalls having built the weapon herself under Luke's tutelage. This description may imply that it is actually her original lightsaber from ''The Thrawn Trilogy'', despite now featuring a different blade color. Additionally, the cover art for ''Planet of Twilight'' appears to have a yellow hue, spawning the misconception that Leia wields a yellow blade, something that is repeated in ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'''s illustration depicting her duel with Beldorion.

Many artists have depicted Leia's lightsaber hilts as heavily resembling that of [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight" /><ref name="Other" /><ref>[[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Heir to the Empire'' comic series]]</ref><ref>[[Star Wars: Dark Force Rising (comic series)|''Dark Force Rising'' comic series]]</ref> However, the comic adaptation of ''The Last Command'' depicts an original design for the hilt of her first lightsaber, featuring a more complex blade emitter assembly, a front vertical handgrip with activation lever, and a tapered section at the rear that includes a horizontally ridged handgrip that widens toward the pommel.<ref>[[The Last Command 6|''The Last Command'' 6]]</ref>

===Alternative depictions===

There are several non-canonical scenarios, all mutually exclusive, in which Leia commences her Jedi training much earlier in her career, ultimately resulting in her obtaining a lightsaber.

In the graphic novel ''[[Star Wars Infinities: A New Hope]]'', the Rebel Alliance is defeated and Princess Leia finds herself apprenticed to Darth Vader, ultimately using her father's red Sith lightsaber in a final climactic battle with Luke.

[[File:LeiaJedi-TFU2.png|thumb|right|150px|Leia with a yellow lightsaber in ''The Force Unleashed II'' DLC.]]
In the graphic novel ''[[Star Wars Infinities: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', Luke freezes to death on Hoth and Leia takes his place as Yoda's student on Dagobah, assembling her own purple-bladed lightsaber during the last stage of her training. When Vader arrives on Dagobah, Leia duels him with her new lightsaber, during which she severs Vader's arm.

In the downloadable Endor level for ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', Leia confronts the [[Dark Apprentice]], a clone of [[Galen Marek]], in the shield generator bunker on Endor. There, she brandishes a yellow-bladed lightsaber, constructed with the same hilt design as Obi-Wan Kenobi's, having become a Jedi Knight following Luke's death in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The two clash furiously in the generator room, and the fight continues outside, but the Dark Apprentice ultimately overpowers and kills Leia.
